summary: Arkansas Forestry Commission tower in Union County, NHLR-registered in 2023; the Register describes a 100-foot Aermotor MC-39 but gives no build date or fire history.

events.note: Site visit dated 1/24/21 recorded on the Register page; no condition stated
Registered August 2, 2023 as US 1749, AR 24; nominated by Jason Johns

evidence.supports: administered by the Arkansas Forestry Commission
tower is a 100 ft Aermotor MC-39 (height 30.5 m)
evidence.quote: This tower is a 100ft Aermotor MC-39.

evidence.supports: site elevation 331 ft (101 m), separate from tower height
Register entry lists no build year (absence; shows the detail fields present)
Forest Lookouts index lists the tower in Union County with no further detail
Arkansas Forestry Commission established by Act 234 in 1931 and built many more towers
evidence.quote: The Arkansas Forestry Commission was established by Act 234 in 1931, and it too built many more towers.

evidence.supports: Encyclopedia counts forty-six still standing in 2023
Preserve Arkansas says about 40 remain standing

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Encyclopedia of Arkansas gives forty-six standing in 2023; Preserve Arkansas gives about 40. Story reports both.

notes_for_editor: Only tower-specific source is the NHLR entry; the Forest Lookouts index names the tower and county only. Two web searches found nothing else under this name. The brief's 'standing' status is not stated on the Register page, so it is omitted from facts; confirm before publishing. The Register gives no build date and no access note, so access is omitted. Brief's elevation_m 100.9 is ground elevation; height_m 30.5 comes from the 100ft description.
